1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.EdgeLocalMetric
2 
3 /-! Away from the original vertices, the actual polyhedral boundary admits
4 planar neighborhoods preserving its shortest-path metric. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set
9 
10 /-- An internal flat neighborhood with its actual surface map and metric meaning. -/
11 structure FlatChart (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (z : Space) where
12   domain : Set Plane
13   open_domain : IsOpen domain
14   origin : Plane
15   origin_mem : origin ∈ domain
16   map : Plane → Space
17   continuous : Continuous map
18   at_origin : map origin = z
19   on_surface : MapsTo map domain (frontier P.body)
20   distance : ∀ x ∈ domain, ∀ y ∈ domain, P.surfaceDist (map x) (map y) = dist x y
21   covers : ∃ U : Set Space, IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧ U ∩ frontier P.body ⊆ map '' domain
22 
23 namespace EdgeFolding
24 
25 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {center : Space} {facets : P.NormalizedFacets center}
26   {F G : P.Face} (chart : EdgeFolding facets F G)
27 
28 /-- Any positive planar disk covers some neighborhood of its central edge point. -/
29 theorem disk_covers_neighborhood (shared : P.ShareEdge F G) {z : Space}
30     (hz : z ∈ F.val ∩ G.val) (not_vertex : z ∉ P.vertices) {ε : ℝ} (positive : 0 < ε) :
31     ∃ U : Set Space, IsOpen U ∧ z ∈ U ∧
32       U ∩ frontier P.body ⊆ chart.fold.map '' Metric.ball (chart.left z) ε := by
33   obtain ⟨U₀, open₀, z₀, only_two⟩ := P.edge_neighborhood_two_facets F G shared hz not_vertex
34   let V := Metric.ball (chart.left z) ε
35   let U : Set Space := U₀ ∩ (chart.left ⁻¹' V ∩ chart.right ⁻¹' V)
36   have openU : IsOpen U := open₀.inter
37     ((Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage chart.left.continuous_of_finiteDimensional).inter
38       (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage chart.right.continuous_of_finiteDimensional))
39   have origin : chart.left z ∈ V := Metric.mem_ball_self positive
40   have zU : z ∈ U := ⟨z₀, origin, by change chart.right z ∈ V; rwa [← chart.joined hz]⟩
41   refine ⟨U, openU, zU, ?_⟩
42   intro x hx
43   rcases only_two ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩ with first | second
44   · exact ⟨chart.left x, hx.1.2.1, chart.fold_left first⟩
45   · exact ⟨chart.right x, hx.1.2.2, chart.fold_right second⟩
46 
47 include chart in
48 /-- The constructed edge neighborhood supplies a flat chart in the intrinsic metric. -/
49 theorem flat_chart (shared : P.ShareEdge F G) {z : Space}
50     (hz : z ∈ F.val ∩ G.val) (not_vertex : z ∉ P.vertices) : Nonempty (P.FlatChart z) := by
51   obtain ⟨near⟩ := chart.exists_neighborhood shared hz not_vertex
52   obtain ⟨ε, positive, disk_in, isometric⟩ := near.exists_isometric_disk shared hz not_vertex
53   exact ⟨{
54     domain := Metric.ball (chart.left z) ε
55     open_domain := Metric.isOpen_ball
56     origin := chart.left z
57     origin_mem := Metric.mem_ball_self positive
58     map := chart.fold.map
59     continuous := chart.fold.continuous
60     at_origin := chart.fold_left hz.1
61     on_surface := fun x hx => near.on_surface ⟨x, disk_in hx, rfl⟩
62     distance := isometric
63     covers := chart.disk_covers_neighborhood shared hz not_vertex positive }⟩
64 
65 end EdgeFolding
66 
67 /-- A point belonging to only one original face has a rigid planar chart. -/
68 theorem flat_chart_in_single_face {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (F : P.Face) {z : Space}
69     (hz : z ∈ F.val) (unique : ∀ G : P.Face, z ∈ G.val → G = F) : Nonempty (P.FlatChart z) := by
70   obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
71   obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
72   obtain ⟨U₁, open₁, z₁, plane⟩ := facets.single_face_local_plane F hz unique
73   obtain ⟨place, rigid⟩ := F.exists_rigid_placement
74   obtain ⟨lift, in_plane, left_inverse, right_inverse, lift_rigid⟩ := F.exists_rigid_plane_inverse place rigid
75   let V : Set Plane := lift ⁻¹' U₁
76   have openV : IsOpen V := open₁.preimage lift.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
77   have origin : place z ∈ V := by change lift (place z) ∈ U₁; rwa [right_inverse z (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hz)]
78   have in_face (x : Plane) (hx : x ∈ V) : lift x ∈ F.val := by
79     have member : lift x ∈ U₁ ∩ (affineSpan ℝ F.val : Set Space) := ⟨hx, in_plane x⟩
80     rw [← plane] at member
81     exact member.2
82   obtain ⟨U₀, open₀, z₀, incident⟩ := P.incident_facets_neighborhood z
83   let U : Set Space := U₀ ∩ place ⁻¹' V
84   have openU : IsOpen U := open₀.inter (openV.preimage place.continuous_of_finiteDimensional)
85   have covered : U ∩ frontier P.body ⊆ lift '' V := by
86     intro x hx
87     obtain ⟨G, xG⟩ := P.boundary_point_in_face hx.2
88     have same := unique G (incident x hx.1.1 G xG)
89     subst G
90     exact ⟨place x, hx.1.2, right_inverse x (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ xG)⟩
91   exact ⟨{
92     domain := V, open_domain := openV, origin := place z, origin_mem := origin
93     map := lift, continuous := lift.continuous_of_finiteDimensional
94     at_origin := right_inverse z (subset_affineSpan ℝ _ hz)
95     on_surface := fun x hx => F.subset_frontier (in_face x hx)
96     distance := fun x hx y hy => (P.surfaceDist_eq_dist_in_face F (in_face x hx) (in_face y hy)).trans (lift_rigid x y)
97     covers := ⟨U, openU, ⟨z₀, origin⟩, covered⟩ }⟩
98 
99 /-- Every boundary point except an original vertex has an actual flat metric chart. -/
100 theorem exists_flat_chart (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {z : Space}
101     (surface : z ∈ frontier P.body) (not_vertex : z ∉ P.vertices) : Nonempty (P.FlatChart z) := by
102   rcases P.nonvertex_incident_facets surface not_vertex with ⟨F, hz, unique⟩ | ⟨F, G, shared, hz, _⟩
103   · exact flat_chart_in_single_face F hz unique
104   · obtain ⟨center, inside⟩ := P.solid
105     obtain ⟨facets⟩ := P.exists_normalized_facets inside
106     obtain ⟨chart⟩ := exists_edge_folding facets F G shared
107     exact chart.flat_chart shared hz not_vertex
108 
109 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
